notes.title: Endgame Vendor Patch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944918/34a2da1fafafdb8ae1d3882c515950bece810277.png

New Vendor Added

Engam Ven Dur has arrived in the village and is selling items in exchange for Mysterious Crystals.
You get one Mysterious Crystal for defeating Easy Mode. You get two for Hard Mode.
Engam has these items for sale currently:

Calamity
24 Damage
Medium Speed
Creates storm clouds on impact.

Goblinbane Armor
250 Life
33% Chance to summon goblin on kill.

Yeti Heart
Summon a yeti to fight for you.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a visual bug where summoned monsters would appear to hurt allied players despite being on the same team.
Fixed a bug where non-player bullets were increasing the Ragath's Rage counter.
Fixed a visual bug where summoned enemies would produce pop-up numbers when their projectiles did damage.
Fixed Panda's hitbox so all shots will collide with it from now on. (Sorry Panda!)

As always please let me know if you find any bugs. Thank you!

~Chris

PS: This new update will add items to the game and change the structure of the save file. If you get kicked from the game it is most likely due to a version issue which you can resolve by restarting steam to force a download of the latest update.

notes.title: Hero's Call Patch
notes.content:
The Hero's Call patch focuses on two things: Achievements to unlock new items and item synergies. Now you can start attempting to combine elite items with different prefixes to win the game in many ways. All the new items are named by or for twitch followers on twitch.tv/markco_wins .


New Prefixes Added!

Penetrating Prefix - 33% chance to apply vulnerable.
Gilding Prefix - 5% chance to turn an enemy to gold, killing them while gilded adds extra gold.
Wise Prefix - Kills grant 1 maximum health.
Lush Prefix - Drinking any non healing potions heals you for 25 life regardless of the effect. (assuming you survive). When at full life increases your max health by 5.
Voodoo Prefix - Kills spawn a twisted zombie at the death location 33% of the time.
Cunning Prefix - deals bonus damage against enemies with potion affects on them (50% per).
Cleric's Prefix - Receive 100% more healing from potions and other affects.

New Potions!

Vulnerable Potion - Take 33% additional damage.
Gilded Potion - Turn enemy to gold.
Shielding Potion +3 shield life per second for 30 seconds.

New Weapons!

Midas Mace: Deals +1 damage per 50 gold you have.
Kerunix Phantom: Passes through walls.
Raagath's Rage: Gain +1 damage per consecutive hit, up to 10.
Edge's World Ender: Giant sword that has a huge reload timer but deals massive damage. If the sword kills then the recharge happens much faster (normal weapon speed).
Tristan Sai: Applies weakness.
Hero's Cutlas: fire a second cutlas on third attack.
Aekeron Spear: inflict vulnerability.
Icepick: Deal 100% more damage to frozen or slowed enemies.

New Armor!

Midas Armor - Melee enemies that hit you turn to gold.
Geo Armor: Using a magical item spawns a wave of rocks that deals high damage.
Living Armor: 33% chance to deal 10% of maximum life as damage.
0x029a Armor: Like zeus armor but spawns a pyro wave every 3 seconds to nearby enemies.
Selbarmor: Releases three homing fireballs when hitting enemy with a potion.
Xaotic Armor: Attack 25% faster while affected by a potion.
Maxpi Calculation: Deal 25% more damage while affected by a potion.
Pandas Scroll: Creates a panda that falls to the ground and tanks enemies (cries on hit).
Sabrina's Locket: Add 15 shielding on use. Gain +2% damage per shield point you have.
Saku's Lute: Create notes that hover in place and damage nearby enemies.
Favorite Stein: Makes you drunk and you deal 50% more damage while drunk.
Snake Charmer: Spawns two gorgon worms to fight for you.

notes.title: Coming Soon - Hero's Call Patch
notes.content:
Hero's Call

The launch is going really well and I wanted to thank everyone for doing their part in spreading the word about this game! That is why I'm hard at work naming items in the upcoming patch after YOU, the twitch followers who made this launch successful.

Coming Soon

- 8 New Prefixes to Items
- 3 New Potions
- 11 Elite Weapons
- 8 Elite Armor
- 10 On Use Items
- ACHIEVEMENTS

One note on achievements, many of the new items will be "unlocked" by obtaining these achievements. This will add a whole new way to play the game with your friends in order to work together and knock out all the achievements.

Future patches after Hero's Call will contain additional content such as alternative levels, new bosses and new games. Follow me on twitch.tv/markco_wins for weekday updates 7-9 PM EST.

notes.title: Final Beta Weekend Before Launch June 15th
notes.content:
Thank you again Rogues for testing so thoroughly these past few months. When the first content patch is released, many of the testers will have items named after them. Watch twitch.tv/markco_wins for content updates live.


 Health potions used at max health now increase your maximum health by 25, up from 10.
 Poison now ticks every 2 seconds instead of every 3 seconds on enemies.
 Healing and Regen potions have been reduced to healing 100 health.
 Axe, Sword, and Lance damage has been buffed to be closer to the mace's damage.
 Tyrion's health in multiplayer has been drastically reduced.


Once we get through initial launch and all potential bugs are squashed, I will announce a date for the "Hero's Call" content update.
